sentences.english: I like your shoes.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢你的鞋子。
sentences.scene: 看到朋友的新鞋随口夸赞

sentences.english: She looks just like her mom when she smiles.
sentences.chinese: 她笑起来的时候跟她妈妈长得一模一样。
sentences.scene: 谈论家人长相相似

sentences.english: I didn't like coffee at first, but after trying a really good latte, I started to enjoy it and now I drink it every morning.
sentences.chinese: 起初我不喜欢咖啡，但在喝了一杯特别好喝的拿铁之后，我开始喜欢上了，现在每天早上都要喝。
sentences.scene: 讲述口味逐渐改变的经历

sentences.english: That dog is so fluffy.
sentences.chinese: 那只狗毛茸茸的。
sentences.scene: 在路边看到一只可爱的狗

sentences.english: We take our dog for a walk every evening after dinner.
sentences.chinese: 我们每天晚饭后都带狗出去散步。
sentences.scene: 讲述家庭遛狗习惯

sentences.english: Our neighbor's dog barks every time the mailman comes, but he's actually really friendly and just wants attention.
sentences.chinese: 邻居的狗每次看到邮递员来都要叫，但它其实特别友好，只是想要引起关注。
sentences.scene: 聊起邻居家那只爱叫但亲人的狗

sentences.english: Do you have a pet?
sentences.chinese: 你养宠物吗？
sentences.scene: 和新认识的朋友找话题聊天

sentences.english: My daughter wants a pet rabbit for her birthday.
sentences.chinese: 我女儿生日想要一只宠物兔子。
sentences.scene: 家长之间聊孩子的心愿

sentences.english: We adopted a pet cat from the shelter last month, and it took her a few days to feel comfortable, but now she sleeps on my bed every night.
sentences.chinese: 上个月我们从收容所领养了一只宠物猫，它花了几天才慢慢适应，但现在每天晚上都睡在我床上。
sentences.scene: 分享领养宠物的温馨经历

sentences.english: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.
sentences.chinese: 猫在沙发上睡觉。
sentences.scene: 随口描述家中的情景

sentences.english: My cat follows me around the house like a little shadow.
sentences.chinese: 我家的猫像个小影子一样，我在屋里走到哪它跟到哪。
sentences.scene: 形容猫咪粘人的可爱习惯

sentences.english: I used to think cats were unfriendly, but then I met my friend's cat who jumped on my lap and started purring, and now I'm a cat person.
sentences.chinese: 我以前觉得猫不亲近人，但后来见到朋友家的猫跳到我腿上开始打呼噜，现在我完全成了一个爱猫的人。
sentences.scene: 因为一次亲密接触改变了对猫的看法

sentences.english: I had fish for lunch.
sentences.chinese: 我午饭吃了鱼。
sentences.scene: 简单说起午餐吃了什么

sentences.english: We keep a few small fish in a tank in the living room.
sentences.chinese: 我们在客厅的鱼缸里养了几条小鱼。
sentences.scene: 介绍家里的观赏鱼

sentences.english: My grandpa takes me fishing every summer, and even if we don't catch anything, we just sit on the boat and talk for hours.
sentences.chinese: 我爷爷每年夏天都带我去钓鱼，就算一条也钓不到，我们也会坐在船上聊好几个钟头。
sentences.scene: 怀念和爷爷一起钓鱼的夏日时光

sentences.english: Listen to that bird sing!
sentences.chinese: 听那只鸟唱歌！
sentences.scene: 清晨听到窗外鸟鸣

sentences.english: A little bird built a nest right outside my window.
sentences.chinese: 一只小鸟刚好在我窗外筑了个巢。
sentences.scene: 惊喜地发现窗外的小鸟邻居

sentences.english: I woke up to the sound of birds chirping this morning, and it was so peaceful that I just lay in bed for an extra ten minutes.
sentences.chinese: 今天早上我被鸟叫声唤醒，那种感觉宁静极了，我在床上多赖了十分钟才起来。
sentences.scene: 周末清晨享受自然的片刻宁静

sentences.english: The rabbit has long ears.
sentences.chinese: 那只兔子有对长耳朵。
sentences.scene: 带孩子观察兔子时说的话

sentences.english: We saw a wild rabbit in the garden eating our carrots.
sentences.chinese: 我们看到一只野兔在菜园里偷吃我们的胡萝卜。
sentences.scene: 在自家菜园里和野生动物偶遇

sentences.english: My cousin has a pet rabbit that's litter-trained and hops around the house freely, just like a cat.
sentences.chinese: 我表妹养了一只宠物兔，会上厕所，还在屋里自由自在地蹦来蹦去，简直跟猫一样。
sentences.scene: 听说别人家有个性的宠物

sentences.english: Let's go to the park.
sentences.chinese: 我们去公园吧。
sentences.scene: 提议一起出门活动

sentences.english: I go to the gym every morning before work.
sentences.chinese: 我每天早上上班前都去健身房。
sentences.scene: 聊起自己雷打不动的晨练习惯

sentences.english: I wanted to go to the concert, but the tickets were sold out, so we went to a nice restaurant instead and still had a great time.
sentences.chinese: 我本来想去看那场演唱会的，但票卖光了，于是我们就去了家不错的餐厅，结果照样玩得很开心。
sentences.scene: 计划泡汤后临时换个地方照样快乐

sentences.english: We went to the zoo yesterday.
sentences.chinese: 我们昨天去了动物园。
sentences.scene: 简单告诉别人昨天的行程

sentences.english: The kids love watching the monkeys at the zoo.
sentences.chinese: 孩子们特别喜欢在动物园看猴子。
sentences.scene: 一家人在动物园里闲逛

sentences.english: We spent the whole day at the zoo, and by the time we saw the lions, my little brother was so tired he fell asleep in the stroller.
sentences.chinese: 我们在动物园待了一整天，等走到狮子区的时候，小弟弟已经累得在手推车里睡着了。
sentences.scene: 带娃逛动物园累并快乐的一天

sentences.english: I saw a fox last night.
sentences.chinese: 我昨晚看到一只狐狸。
sentences.scene: 晚上开车或回家时巧遇狐狸

sentences.english: A fox comes into our backyard every once in a while.
sentences.chinese: 有只狐狸隔三差五就跑到我家后院来。
sentences.scene: 和邻居聊起常来串门的狐狸

sentences.english: We were camping when a fox walked right past our tent; it stared at us for a second and then disappeared into the woods.
sentences.chinese: 我们露营的时候，一只狐狸径直走过帐篷，看了我们几秒，接着就消失在树林里了。
sentences.scene: 在野外与狐狸近距离对视的奇妙瞬间

chinese_meaning: 小姐；老师（用于未婚女性姓氏前）

sentences.english: Good morning, Miss Li.
sentences.chinese: 早上好，李老师/李小姐。
sentences.scene: 学生在校门口向老师问好

sentences.english: Our new English teacher, Miss Parker, is really funny.
sentences.chinese: 我们新来的英语老师帕克小姐特别有趣。
sentences.scene: 同学之间讨论新来的老师

sentences.english: I remember my first-grade teacher, Miss Davis, who taught me to love reading by reading us stories every single day.
sentences.chinese: 我还记得我一年级的老师戴维斯小姐，她每天都给我们读故事，让我从此爱上了阅读。
sentences.scene: 怀念童年那位点燃阅读兴趣的老师

sentences.english: Pandas eat bamboo.
sentences.chinese: 熊猫吃竹子。
sentences.scene: 给孩子介绍熊猫的习性

sentences.english: We waited in line for an hour to see the baby panda.
sentences.chinese: 我们为了看熊猫宝宝排了一小时的队。
sentences.scene: 在动物园排队看人气动物

sentences.english: Seeing a panda in real life was amazing; it looked just like a giant stuffed animal, sitting there and munching on bamboo without a care.
sentences.chinese: 亲眼看到熊猫的感觉太奇妙了，它就像一只巨大的毛绒玩具，坐在那里无忧无虑地嚼着竹子。
sentences.scene: 第一次近距离看到熊猫时的兴奋感叹

sentences.english: Look at that cute red panda!
sentences.chinese: 快看那只可爱的小熊猫！
sentences.scene: 在动物园小熊猫馆前兴奋地指给孩子看

sentences.english: The red panda was curled up on a branch, sleeping in the sun.
sentences.chinese: 那只小熊猫蜷在树枝上，在阳光下睡觉。
sentences.scene: 描述小熊猫在园内的萌态

sentences.english: I used to think a red panda was a baby panda, but I learned they're a totally different animal with a long, bushy tail that helps them balance.
sentences.chinese: 我以前以为小熊猫是熊猫宝宝，后来才知道它们是完全不同的动物，有一条长长的、毛茸茸的尾巴来帮助平衡。
sentences.scene: 纠正对小熊猫的误解，增长动物知识

sentences.english: Your puppy is so cute!
sentences.chinese: 你的小狗好可爱呀！
sentences.scene: 看到朋友新养的宠物

sentences.english: She wore a cute hat with little ears on it.
sentences.chinese: 她戴了一顶有对小耳朵的可爱帽子。
sentences.scene: 描述别人有趣的穿搭

sentences.english: My niece did this cute little dance when she heard the music, and everyone at the party gathered around to watch.
sentences.chinese: 我侄女一听到音乐就跳起一支可爱的小舞蹈，派对上的所有人都围过来看。
sentences.scene: 家庭聚会中小孩成为全场焦点

sentences.english: The monkey is climbing the tree.
sentences.chinese: 那只猴子在爬树。
sentences.scene: 带孩子逛动物园时的现场描述

sentences.english: A monkey at the park tried to take my sunglasses!
sentences.chinese: 公园里有只猴子想抢走我的太阳镜！
sentences.scene: 在景区遭遇调皮的猴子

sentences.english: When we visited Bali, monkeys were everywhere around the temple, and one of them opened my bag and stole a banana right out of it.
sentences.chinese: 我们在巴厘岛玩的时候，寺庙周围到处都是猴子，其中有一只竟拉开我的包，直接把里面的香蕉给偷走了。
sentences.scene: 旅行时被猴子“打劫”的有趣经历

sentences.english: Tigers have stripes.
sentences.chinese: 老虎身上有条纹。
sentences.scene: 给小朋友讲解动物特征

sentences.english: We heard a tiger roar during the safari tour.
sentences.chinese: 在野生动物园游览时，我们听到了老虎的吼叫声。
sentences.scene: 在野生动物园里的震撼体验

sentences.english: I'll never forget the moment the tiger walked right up to the glass at the zoo; it was so close I could see its golden eyes.
sentences.chinese: 我永远忘不了在动物园老虎径直走到玻璃前的那一刻，近得我连它金黄色的眼睛都能看得一清二楚。
sentences.scene: 与猛兽隔窗相望的难忘瞬间

sentences.english: Elephants are very smart.
sentences.chinese: 大象非常聪明。
sentences.scene: 和朋友聊起喜欢的大象

sentences.english: We rode an elephant in Thailand last summer.
sentences.chinese: 去年夏天我们在泰国骑了大象。
sentences.scene: 分享旅行中特别的体验

sentences.english: The elephant at the sanctuary gently took food from my hand with its trunk, and it felt both ticklish and magical.
sentences.chinese: 保护区里的大象用鼻子温柔地从我手里取走食物，那种感觉又痒又神奇。
sentences.scene: 在动物保护区与大象互动的奇妙感

sentences.english: The lion is sleeping in the sun.
sentences.chinese: 狮子在太阳底下睡觉。
sentences.scene: 在动物园看到狮子懒洋洋的样子

sentences.english: In the movie, the lion cub learns to be brave.
sentences.chinese: 电影里，那只小狮子学会了勇敢。
sentences.scene: 和孩子讨论看过的动画电影

sentences.english: I always thought lions were scary, but when I saw them at the zoo they were just lounging around like big lazy cats.
sentences.chinese: 我一直觉得狮子很吓人，但在动物园看到它们就像大懒猫一样瘫在那里，感觉完全不一样了。
sentences.scene: 发现猛兽也有慵懒可爱的一面

sentences.english: What's your favorite animal?
sentences.chinese: 你最喜欢什么动物？
sentences.scene: 小孩子之间最常见的聊天话题

sentences.english: We're learning about different animal habitats in science class.
sentences.chinese: 我们在科学课上学习不同动物的栖息地。
sentences.scene: 学生跟家长汇报课堂内容

sentences.english: My dream job is to be a vet so I can help sick animals, because I've loved every kind of animal since I was a little kid.
sentences.chinese: 我的梦想是当一名兽医，帮助生病的动物，因为我从小就喜欢各种小动物。
sentences.scene: 和朋友分享未来职业的理想

sentences.english: Giraffes have long necks.
sentences.chinese: 长颈鹿有很长的脖子。
sentences.scene: 指着绘本给孩子讲解

sentences.english: We fed a giraffe at the zoo and its tongue was purple!
sentences.chinese: 我们在动物园喂长颈鹿，它的舌头居然是紫色的！
sentences.scene: 兴奋地分享喂食动物的新奇发现

sentences.english: Seeing a giraffe up close is incredible because they look so gentle, and their eyelashes are ridiculously long and pretty.
sentences.chinese: 近距离看长颈鹿的感觉真是难以置信，它们看起来非常温顺，而且睫毛长得不可思议，漂亮极了。
sentences.scene: 在野生动物园近距离观察长颈鹿的感叹

sentences.english: My dad is very tall.
sentences.chinese: 我爸爸很高。
sentences.scene: 向同学介绍家人

sentences.english: She's the tallest girl in our class.
sentences.chinese: 她是我们班个子最高的女生。
sentences.scene: 和别的班同学介绍班级情况

sentences.english: I had to stand on my toes to reach the top shelf, but my tall friend just reached up and grabbed it without any effort.
sentences.chinese: 我得踮起脚尖才能勉强够着顶层架子，而我那位高个子朋友一伸手就轻轻松松拿下来了。
sentences.scene: 矮个子和高个子朋友日常拿东西的对比

sentences.english: He runs really fast.
sentences.chinese: 他跑得非常快。
sentences.scene: 看运动会时评价选手

sentences.english: The fast train gets you downtown in ten minutes.
sentences.chinese: 坐那趟快车到市中心只要十分钟。
sentences.scene: 给别人指路或推荐交通方式

sentences.english: I ate my breakfast so fast this morning that I got a stomachache, so I'm never doing that again.
sentences.chinese: 今天早上我早饭吃得太快，结果搞得肚子疼，我以后再也不敢这么狼吞虎咽了。
sentences.scene: 分享早晨匆忙带来的小教训
